summary: Quiet residential bend with houses 12-23 m away all round.
reasons: Dwellings 12-23 m away on own side
No parking convention on quiet street
Verge looks wide enough to stop

best_section.where: Outer bend of Minkara Street, before the turning head, beside the pale roofed house

drivers.seclusion: Homes on the west side 12-23 m back and more across the road; no bush or park buffer.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed residential street, verge and kerb room beside the lane; no gate on the way in.
drivers.traffic: Local residents only on a short loop; very little through traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars or vans seen parked along the kerb here, so a van would stand out.

flags: Steep: about 5% grade rising towards the turning head
Mapped gate 91 m away has a way round, not on the only access
sun_shade: Mostly open; tree canopy shades the west side, morning sun from the east.
